text:
Applying the policy in order: flag takes precedence.

T6 reports a same_serial duplicate with another claim (e61722a8-...). Under the policy, any shared serial number triggers flag, which comes before deny or needs_info. The other checks (model match T2, legible label T1, date code in range T3, purchase before the window T4) would otherwise lead to a deny on the purchase date, since 2016-04-22 is before the 2017-01-01 sale window. The flag rule still controls the outcome, so the claim goes to a person with the matching claim.

The destruction photo (T5) also does not clearly show the instructed destruction, which would have supported needs_info. It does not change the outcome, but it is worth noting for the reviewer.

reasons.text: The claim shares a serial number with another claim (e61722a8-2842-5ea3-ad00-f1e0f9646b72), so it must be sent to a person for duplicate review together with the matching claim.
The label photo is legible and shows the recalled model B0726Y, and the date code 8/21 is in range, so the model and date code are confirmed.
The purchase was dated 2016-04-22, which is before the 2017-01-01 sale window, so on its own it would be a denial. The retailer Amazon is listed.
The destruction photo does not clearly show the helmet with its straps cut off, which would also require a new photo if the claim proceeds.
